reason: Dogs and cats are by far the most common pets and the first ones people think of. Fish, birds and hamsters are the next most familiar everyday pets.
Crowd answers for kitchen items: the big appliances come first, especially the refrigerator, then the stove/oven and the sink, followed by everyday items like the microwave and dishes/utensils.

These are the red fruits the average person thinks of first. Apple is by far the most common answer, then strawberry and cherry. Raspberry and watermelon (red inside) round out the top five. A few people might say tomato, but fewer than these.
These are the everyday beach items most people would name first. Towels are almost always brought, followed by sunscreen, an umbrella, a cooler or food, and chairs.
These are the breakfast foods most Americans think of first. Eggs and bacon are the classic answers, and pancakes, cereal and toast are the next most common.
US survey crowd answers: the big team sports with balls come to mind first. Basketball and football lead, followed by baseball, soccer and tennis.

People in a survey would most likely name the first color of the rainbow and the familiar primary colors. Red comes first in the sequence and is the most familiar, followed by blue, yellow and green. Purple is more common than orange, indigo or violet as an everyday name.

These are the answers I'd expect most people to give, ranked by my own judgment, with no survey data behind them. Eating cake is the most common birthday activity. Having a party, opening presents, going out to eat and blowing out candles come next.
These are my best guesses at the most common survey answers. Overslept is the classic top answer. Traffic is next. Car trouble, kids and a missed bus or train come after that.

Bread would be by far the most common answer. Next come the usual fillings: lunch meat, cheese, mayonnaise and other condiments, and peanut butter. A knife and lettuce are reasonable answers but probably less common.

Most people name the classic, widely known heroes first. Superman and Batman lead because they are iconic and have been around for decades. Spider-Man comes next, followed by Wonder Woman and Iron Man, who are well known from films.
These are the everyday answers most people would give first. Sleeping or napping and watching TV are the most common, then reading, taking a bath and listening to music.
Broccoli is the classic answer for vegetables kids hate, and Brussels sprouts come right after it. Spinach, peas and cauliflower are other common, everyday answers.
McDonald's is by far the most iconic fast food chain, so it would get the most answers. Burger King, Wendy's, Taco Bell and KFC are the next most familiar chains to average adults.

These are my best guesses at the most common answers, not real survey results. "Car" is the obvious first answer. Bicycle, truck, skateboard and bus are the next everyday vehicles most people would think of.

Mars is the planet people name most often. Jupiter and Saturn are well known because they are large, and Saturn has its rings. Earth is an obvious answer, but many people skip it. Venus is also familiar to most people.
Most people would say piano or guitar first, since they're the instruments everyone knows. Drums and violin come next, and trumpet or flute would round out the top answers.

Christmas is by far the most common answer. Hanukkah comes next, then New Year's Eve, then Kwanzaa. Christmas Eve and Boxing Day are smaller picks, and Christmas Eve is the more likely one in a US survey.
For Halloween, most people would think of candy and pumpkins/jack-o'-lanterns first. After that come costumes, trick-or-treating, and ghosts or witches.

These are my best guesses at the most common answers to "name a job that requires a uniform." I based them on general knowledge, not survey data. Police officer is the obvious first answer. Military/soldier, nurse/doctor, firefighter and fast-food/restaurant worker are also answers most people would give.

These are the things most people would think of first when picturing what's inside a wallet. Money or cash is the obvious top answer. Credit or debit cards and a driver's license or ID come next. Photos are a classic everyday answer, and receipts are a common item that clutters up a wallet.
Classic hot dog condiments in order of how popular they are with the average American crowd: mustard and ketchup come first, then relish, onions and chili/sauerkraut.
These are the rooms most people name first. Kitchen and bedroom are the usual top answers, followed by bathroom, living room and dining room.

These are the most common everyday weather words. Rain is the most typical example, followed by snow, sunny, cloudy and windy. Storms and hail are plausible but less often the first answer people give.

Typical crowd answers for first-date activities: going out to eat comes first by a wide margin, followed by seeing a movie, talking or getting to know each other, kissing, and getting drinks or coffee.

These are the most common everyday things people link with "cold". Ice and snow are the obvious first answers. A freezer or refrigerator and ice cream are close behind. Winter or the weather finishes the list.
Guessing like the crowd: being sick is the obvious top answer, then a routine checkup, then getting hurt. Pain and getting a prescription or refill round out the everyday reasons.
These are the fears people name most often in surveys and pop culture. Spiders, snakes and heights usually top the list, followed by death and the dark.

These are the insects most people name first. Ants, flies, bees and mosquitoes are everyday insects that everyone runs into, so they come to mind fastest. Cockroach fits the 'bug' idea and is a very common answer. I left out spider: lots of people would say it, but it is not an insect.

On a plane, most people would first think of a carry-on bag or luggage. After that come a pillow, a book, headphones and a phone or other device. ID and passport are also common answers, but I ranked them a little lower.
